label: Gemini CLI Access
description: A Gemini CLI login, for the GeminiCli nodes' `access`: a Gemini API key or a Vertex AI key, anywhere. One access for however many GeminiCli nodes. Your Google account login is not offered here: Google's terms call using the Gemini CLI login from third-party software a violation, so it is never copied into a connection. On your own machine, leave `access` unwired and Gemini CLI uses the login it already has.

steps: Open aistudio.google.com, Get API key, and create a key.
Paste it below and name the connection. Calls are billed to that account.
In the Google Cloud console, create an API key for Vertex AI (its express mode).
Paste it below and name the connection. Calls are billed to that Google Cloud project.

outputs.name: access
outputs.description: Wire into the GeminiCli nodes' `access` input.
